violation_type.title: Indoor Useable Space (26 TAC §747.4005)
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection in the day care main room, the operation had limited open space for group activities. The area was crowded with  learning and playing equipment leaving no open space for children to move around freely. Photos taken.    This was corrected at inspection after several pieces of equipment were removed from the area to free up space for children. Photos taken.
